name: Wonderland
detailed_description:
Step into Wonderland — a psychological horror game where every memory is a trap and every shadow whispers the past. You play as Mahdi, a man searching for his missing brother in a world where reality fractures under grief, guilt, and imagination gone wrong.

Explore dreamlike environments shaped by trauma: an abandoned toy factory, endless subways, looping corridors, and haunted childhood homes. Each area reflects a different part of the mind — unstable, shifting, and dangerous.

Nothing is fixed. Time loops, spaces lie, and choices matter.

Key Features

  • Narrative-Driven Horror – No exposition dumps. Everything you see, hear, or miss carries part of the story.

  • Environmental Puzzles – Solve symbolic challenges tied to memory, emotion, and trauma.

  • Dynamic Levels – Escape collapsing subways, break memory loops, or lose yourself in shifting architecture.

  • Immersive Sound Design – Every sound matters. Headphones recommended.

  • Surreal World-Building – Each environment is handcrafted to blur the line between dream and nightmare.

Built with Unreal Engine 5, Wonderland delivers an atmosphere both surreal and grounded. There are no safe spaces here — just questions, echoes, and the hope that what’s lost can be found.

Will you uncover the truth, or become a memory yourself?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated sound card with surround support
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated sound card with surround support
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading times
